attr.title: RetroBIOS
attr.desc: Checks the BIOS folder of this system against the files its emulators read, and downloads the missing ones from the RetroBIOS collection, each verified by its hash.
attr.inst: Downloads the files with a network connection. Without one, copy the BIOS pack of the system (a _BIOS_Pack.zip file from github.com/Abdess/retrobios/releases) into ports/retrobios. Uses the system's Python 3.8 or newer, or PortMaster's python_3.11 runtime on aarch64.
